guard_streams.source: January 2026 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
guard_streams.write_limit: Regional UPRN files express BDUK's June 2026 current view and require exact regional file, UPRN, schema and current-service validation before parcel promotion.

facts.detail: The January 2026 OMR publication was published on 4 June 2026.
The publication applies to England and Wales.
It is published by BDUK and DSIT.
The publication includes an HTML UPRN-level user guide and technical note.
It provides a 174 KB sample CSV.
The North East regional ZIP is listed as 16 MB.
The North West regional ZIP is listed as 44 MB.
The South East regional ZIP is listed as 53.4 MB.
The South West regional ZIP is listed as 36.6 MB.
The release covers OMR determinations, current connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK interventions.

guard_streams.source: September 2025 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
guard_streams.write_limit: This corrected January/February 2026 transparency release is a dated BDUK view and cannot replace exact current premises service validation.

facts.detail: The September 2025 OMR publication was published on 8 January 2026.
It was updated on 2 February 2026.
The publication applies to England and Wales.
It provides a 173 KB sample CSV.
The North East regional ZIP is listed as 18 MB.
The North West regional ZIP is listed as 46.8 MB.
The South East regional ZIP is listed as 59.3 MB.
The corrected release added a no-geographical-region CSV.
Supplier-name errors were corrected and files were replaced.
The release covers OMR determinations, current connectivity, future plans and BDUK interventions.

guard_streams.source: September 2025 OMR UPRN-level user guide and technical note
guard_streams.write_limit: The guide explicitly records supplier-response, timing, overlap, base-definition and contract-change limitations; fields must not be treated as exact live orderability.

facts.detail: The technical note was updated on 2 February 2026.
It records correction of supplier-name errors in the 8 January dataset.
Regional assignments use NSUL July 2025, NSPL May 2025 and ONSUD November 2025 data.
The release is optimised for programming software and may exceed spreadsheet display limits.
BDUK plans updated releases alongside OMR closure notices about every four months.
The premises base uses AddressBase Premium and excludes non-postal or demolished premises.
The release is split into 318 local-authority files and includes a sample of up to 1,000 rows.
The schema includes White, Grey/Black, Under Review and Unassessed statuses.
The note estimates 3.9% of intervention premises are in more than one intervention.
BDUK states its premises base, respondent set, evaluation methods and reference dates differ from Ofcom PND.
